== Biography ==
David Glasgow was born on 12 May 1742 and baptised on 23 May 1742 in Livingston, Linlithgowshire, Scotland. The Findmypast parish transcript names his parents as Abraham Glasgow and Janet Cunnyngham and records their residence as Daviston.<ref name="FMP">"Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929," Findmypast transcript, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4151485&tab=this David Glasgow, SCOT/OPR/BAP/4151485] (reviewed 23 October 2026), birth 12 May and baptism 23 May 1742, Livingston; Abraham Glasgow and Janet Cunnyngham, residence Daviston; citing OPR 669/1, item 4. Original register image uninspected.</ref> They are represented by [[Glasgow-1227|Abraham Glasgow]] and [[Cunnyngham-118|Janet Cunnyngham]] in the existing family account. Livingston is the record place and baptism locality; the transcript does not independently label David's exact birthplace.
